features.title: Small teams, big flexibility. Swift tables are lightweight, mobile, and designed to make even compact spaces more functional.
Always ready, never in the way. With castors for smooth movement and foldable, stackable design, Swift tables adapt to dynamic spaces.
Swift tables move as fast as your ideas. Perfect for workshops, training, or projects, they bring flexibility and mobility to any setup.
features.text: Built to last, made to move

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
